facts.fact: The scheme is the Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS) under NSAP
facts.quote: National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS) – Persons with severe or multiple disabilities aged 18 years and above.

facts.fact: The person must belong to a BPL family as per Government of India criteria
facts.quote: For getting benefits under NSAP the applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) family according to the criteria prescribed by the Govt. of India.

facts.fact: The person must be 18 years or older, with a disability level of 80%
facts.quote: Indira Gandhi National Disability Pension Scheme (IGNDPS): The eligible age for the pensioner is 18 years and above and the disability level has to be 80%.

facts.fact: Severe disability means 80% or more of one or more disabilities
facts.quote: “persons with severe disability” means a person with 80% or more of one or more disabilities.

facts.fact: Multiple disability means a combination of two or more disabilities
facts.quote: “Multiple Disabilities” means combination of 2 or more disabilities.
Dwarfs will also be an eligible category for this pension

facts.fact: Central assistance is Rs 300 a month (18-79) and Rs 500 a month from age 80
facts.quote: ₹300 per month (18–79 years) ₹500 per month (80 years and above)

facts.fact: States may add their own top-up
facts.quote: 2.4.1 States are strongly urged to provide an additional amount at least an equivalent amount to the assistance provided by the Central Government so that the beneficiaries can get a decent level of assistance.

facts.fact: The application goes to the State department implementing NSAP, locally through the Gram Panchayat/Municipality
facts.quote: At the local level, the Gram Panchayat /Municipality would implement the programmes.

facts.fact: A disability certificate is needed (the form asks for the type of disability as in the certificate)
facts.quote: In case of Disability Pension- Type of Disability____________________________________ (As indicated in certificate)

facts.fact: States are to hold camps where disability certificates are issued on the spot
facts.quote: In case of persons with disability, the State should mandatorily organize camps at convenient localities to which the potential beneficiaries are taken by vehicle free of cost. Disability Certificates should be issued on the spot.

summary: IGNDPS criteria (BPL, 18+, 80% severe/multiple disability, dwarfs), Rs 300/Rs 500, State top-up, certificate camps confirmed on NSAP About Us, FAQ Q6 and the 2014 guidelines.
